questions.prompt: What does the writer allow when an instruction needs a specialized technical name?
questions.explanation:
作者反对不必要的行话，但不要求删去准确指称所必需的术语。保留术语和写清楚可以同时做到。

选项“Invent a new general name even if it is inaccurate.”：原文没有授权用不准确的新称呼替换必要术语。
选项“Remove the action that the reader needs to perform.”：删去需要执行的动作不符合清楚说明的目标。
选项“Keep the necessary term while making the instruction as clear as possible.”：正确：句子先否定删必要术语，再强调清楚。
distractorReasons: 原文没有授权用不准确的新称呼替换必要术语。
删去需要执行的动作不符合清楚说明的目标。
正确：句子先否定删必要术语，再强调清楚。
questions.evidence: When we say not to use jargon, we're not advocating leaving out necessary technical terms, but we are saying to make sure your language is as clear as possible.
options: Invent a new general name even if it is inaccurate.
Remove the action that the reader needs to perform.
Keep the necessary term while making the instruction as clear as possible.
answers: Keep the necessary term while making the instruction as clear as possible.

questions.prompt: Use ONE WORD from the text: In the shorter equipment instruction, what action is the reader told to perform?
questions.explanation:
较短的指令以tighten直接说明要拧紧这个部件；本题只问动作，不要求掌握示例设备名称。

可接受tighten，它是短指令的动作词。
securely说明动作应达到的状态，不是动作本身。
valve是设备名称的一部分，不是动作。
字数与形式：只填原文动词原形tighten，不添加to，也不改为tightened或tightening。
distractorReasons: 可接受tighten，它是短指令的动作词。
securely说明动作应达到的状态，不是动作本身。
valve是设备名称的一部分，不是动作。
questions.evidence: tighten the brinulator valve control ring securely

questions.prompt: What can needless jargon cause even when all readers are specialists?
questions.explanation:
即使受众是专家，超出必要术语的行话仍可能引起误解或疏离感；专业身份不自动保证沟通清楚。

选项“The removal of any need for precise technical terms.”：必要术语仍可能需要，不能由本句推成完全不需要准确术语。
选项“Misunderstanding or a feeling of exclusion.”：正确：misunderstanding or alienation直接列出两种风险。
选项“Automatic agreement about every detail.”：原文没有说会自动达成一致。
distractorReasons: 必要术语仍可能需要，不能由本句推成完全不需要准确术语。
正确：misunderstanding or alienation直接列出两种风险。
原文没有说会自动达成一致。
questions.evidence: However, going beyond necessary technical terms to write in jargon can cause misunderstanding or alienation, even if your only readers are specialists.
options: The removal of any need for precise technical terms.
Misunderstanding or a feeling of exclusion.
answers: Misunderstanding or a feeling of exclusion.

questions.prompt: Why can terms familiar to a writer still be a problem?
questions.explanation:
问题在于作者与受众的知识不相同：作者熟悉的词，读者仍可能难懂或无法理解。

选项“A familiar term always becomes more accurate when the sentence is longer.”：文章没有声称加长句子会使术语更准确。
选项“The writer may not notice that the audience finds them difficult or meaningless.”：正确：because后明确说明作者未意识到读者的困难。
选项“Every reader has studied the same specialist vocabulary as the writer.”：这与原文指出的作者和受众知识差异相反。
distractorReasons: 文章没有声称加长句子会使术语更准确。
正确：because后明确说明作者未意识到读者的困难。
这与原文指出的作者和受众知识差异相反。
questions.evidence: Readers complain about jargon more than any other writing fault, because writers often fail to realize that terms they know well may be difficult or meaningless to their audience.
options: A familiar term always becomes more accurate when the sentence is longer.
The writer may not notice that the audience finds them difficult or meaningless.
Every reader has studied the same specialist vocabulary as the writer.
answers: The writer may not notice that the audience finds them difficult or meaningless.

questions.prompt: Use ONE WORD from the text: The writer says the purpose of writing is to ______ rather than impress.
questions.explanation:
原句以communicate与impress对比，说明写作目的是传达信息，而不是炫耀。

可接受communicate。
impress是作者否定为主要目的的一项，不能填入前半句。
define是处理术语的动作，不是本句概括的写作目的。
字数与形式：只填原文动词原形communicate，不添加to，也不改成名词communication。
distractorReasons: impress是作者否定为主要目的的一项，不能填入前半句。
define是处理术语的动作，不是本句概括的写作目的。
questions.evidence: Remember to write to communicate, not to impress.

questions.prompt: What should writers do when no alternative to a technical term is available?
questions.explanation:
必须使用术语时应说明其含义；紧接着又提醒定义不要过多，因此不是靠堆砌更多术语来解释。

选项“Explain the meaning of the term.”：正确：define your terms就是给出含义。
选项“Assume that the term is obvious to everyone.”：原文要求定义，不能假设人人都懂。
选项“Add more unexplained specialist words around it.”：添加未解释行话会增加理解负担，与原文方向相反。
distractorReasons: 正确：define your terms就是给出含义。
原文要求定义，不能假设人人都懂。
添加未解释行话会增加理解负担，与原文方向相反。
questions.evidence: When you have no way to express an idea except to use technical language, make sure to define your terms. However, it's best to keep definitions to a minimum.
options: Explain the meaning of the term.
Assume that the term is obvious to everyone.
Add more unexplained specialist words around it.
answers: Explain the meaning of the term.
